ja.title: FaceEcho 顔エコー · 表情認識とバーチャルアバター
ja.h1: 🎭 FaceEcho · 顔エコー —— 表情認識 + バーチャルアバター
ja.sub: 感情の判断は論文モデル（GRU-D + 安全考慮損失）に統一しています。MediaPipe は顔のランドマークと 52 次元の Blendshape 特徴を取り出すだけで、その時系列から GRU-D が連続的な感情（valence / arousal）を推定し、5 つの感情・カートゥーン顔・パートナー・推奨距離をすべて決めます。

ja.foot:
感情の判断：GRU-D（論文モデル）の valence/arousal を、ニュートラル顔からのずれとして 5 つの感情の基準点と比べて確率にしています。「ニュートラル顔を校正」で本人の基準を記録します。
MediaPipe FaceLandmarker（468点 + Blendshapes）は特徴抽出のみ。「感情の判断」ボタンで旧ルール（幾何 + Blendshape の融合）に戻せます。すべてローカルで動作します。

zh.title: FaceEcho 脸回声 · 表情识别与虚拟形象
zh.h1: 🎭 FaceEcho · 脸回声 —— 表情识别 + 虚拟形象
zh.sub: 情绪判断统一由论文模型（GRU-D + 安全感知损失）给出。MediaPipe 只负责提取面部关键点和 52 维 Blendshape 特征；GRU-D 根据这串时序特征估计连续情绪（valence / arousal），再决定 5 类情绪、卡通脸的情绪色、伙伴的回应和建议距离。
zh.st_ready: 模型就绪({d})，点击"开启摄像头"
zh.st_noColorCam: 没有可用的彩色摄像头
zh.st_camFail: 无法访问摄像头：{e}（若是 RealSense，请在下拉里手动选带 RGB/Color 或能出彩色画面的那一项）
zh.st_opened: ✅ 已打开：{l}。请保持自然表情，点击"校准中性脸"
zh.st_camBad: 该摄像头打不开（可能是深度/红外流）：{e}
zh.st_switched: ✅ 已切换：{l} 。看到彩色画面即选对了
zh.st_faceFirst: 先让脸出现在画面里，再点生成
zh.h_abstract: 抽象线条脸（跟随你的面部）
zh.h_cartoon: 我的Q版脸（镜像你的动作）
zh.h_3d: 我的3D形象（镜像你的表情）
zh.avatarLoading:
正在加载 3D 形象…
也可点「📦 加载.vrm形象」换一个
zh.avatarMissing:
没找到 avatar.vrm
点「📦 加载.vrm形象」选一个
zh.h_comp: 情绪反馈伙伴（对你的表情做出回应）
zh.compHint: 它不是镜像你，而是根据你的情绪给出回应
zh.calibrating: 🎯 校准中… 保持自然 {s}s（{n} 帧）
zh.foot:
情绪判断：把 GRU-D（论文模型）输出的 valence/arousal 相对你中性脸的偏移，与 5 类情绪的原型点比较，换算成概率。「校准中性脸」会记录你本人的基准。
MediaPipe FaceLandmarker（468 点 + Blendshapes）只做特征提取。点「情绪判断」按钮可切回旧规则（几何 + Blendshape 融合）。全部本地运行。
zh.aff_title: 🧠 连续情绪 · 安全社交距离（论文模型：GRU-D + 安全感知损失）
zh.geo_dbg: 几何：生气 {a}%（{ha}s）· 伤心 {s}%（{hs}s）　持续 1 秒才计入
zh.lg_drop: 红底 = 没看到脸（GRU-D 外推，不冻结）
zh.distLabel: 建议与用户保持的距离
zh.aff_needW: 需要权重 static/models/grud_safety.json：在 5090 上用 tools/train_export_grud.py 训练导出后拷进来。没有它，其余功能照常。
zh.aff_val: 验证集(35%丢帧)：CCC v/a {v}/{ar}，危险违规 {d}%
zh.aff_extrap: 没看到脸时继续按 GRU-D 动力学外推，距离不会卡在旧值。
zh.traj_wait: 开启摄像头后显示最近 12 秒的情绪轨迹
zh.v_none: 语音：系统没有该语言的语音（可用 tools/make_voices.py 生成音频）

zh.aff_noexpr: 表情头：无（旧权重）。5 类情绪由 valence/arousal 换算。

en.title: FaceEcho · Facial Expression Recognition & Avatar
en.sub: All emotion judgements come from the paper model (GRU-D + safety-aware loss). MediaPipe only extracts facial landmarks and 52 blendshape features; GRU-D turns that time series into continuous affect (valence / arousal), which drives the 5 emotion classes, the cartoon face's mood, the companion and the suggested distance.
en.st_camFail: Cannot access camera: {e} (for RealSense, pick the RGB/Color entry from the list manually)
en.st_opened: ✅ Opened: {l}. Keep a relaxed face and click "Calibrate neutral face"
en.st_camBad: This camera can't be opened (probably a depth/IR stream): {e}
en.st_switched: ✅ Switched to: {l}. If you see a color image, it's the right one
en.st_faceFirst: Show your face in the frame first, then generate
en.avatarLoading:
Loading 3D avatar…
You can also use "📦 Load .vrm avatar" to swap it
en.avatarMissing:
avatar.vrm not found
Use "📦 Load .vrm avatar" to pick one
en.compHint: It doesn't mirror you — it responds to how you feel
en.moveCenter: Move your face to the center
en.foot:
Emotion classes: GRU-D's valence/arousal, measured relative to your neutral face, are compared with prototype points for the 5 emotions and turned into probabilities. "Calibrate neutral face" records your personal baseline.
MediaPipe FaceLandmarker (468 points + blendshapes) is only the feature extractor. The "Emotion source" button switches back to the old geometry + blendshape rules. Everything runs locally.
en.aff_title: 🧠 Continuous affect · Safe social distance (paper model: GRU-D + safety-aware loss)
en.geo_dbg: Geometry: angry {a}% ({ha}s) · sad {s}% ({hs}s)  counts after 1 s
en.lg_drop: red = face not visible (GRU-D extrapolates, no freezing)
en.aff_needW: Needs weights static/models/grud_safety.json: train and export them on the 5090 with tools/train_export_grud.py, then copy here. Everything else works without it.
en.aff_val: Validation (35% drop): CCC v/a {v}/{ar}, dangerous violations {d}%
en.aff_extrap: When the face is not visible, GRU-D keeps extrapolating, so the distance never freezes at a stale value.
en.traj_wait: The last 12 s of affect appear after the camera starts
en.v_none: Voice: no system voice for this language (generate audio with tools/make_voices.py)

happy: Seeing you smile makes me so happy! 😄
surprise: So surprised — tell me about it!
sad: Don't be sad, I'm right here with you. 🫂
Take a deep breath. Everything will be okay.
angry: Take it easy, tell me slowly.
Deep breath, let's relax a little.
I understand how you feel. Let's calm down.
Have some water and cool off.
neutral: Can you show me an expression?
Move your face a little, and I'll respond.

en.aff_expr: Expression head: yes (7 classes learned, validation macro-F1 {f}). The 5 emotions come straight from the model.
en.aff_noexpr: Expression head: none (old weights). The 5 emotions are derived from valence/arousal.
en.perf_note: Every frame since start is logged (up to ~20 min)
en.perf_empty: No data yet. Start the camera first.
